headlines.title: Is Southern (SO) Fairly Valued As It Files For 5,000,000 New Shares?
headlines.summary: Southern (SO) has put fresh equity in focus after filing a US$467.85 million shelf registration for 5,000,000 common shares tied to an employee stock ownership plan related offering. Southern’s latest share offering lands after a strong run in the background, with the stock at US$92.47 and a roughly 6.1% year to date share price gain. Total shareholder return of about 78.

headlines.title: What Does Southern (SO) $1.75 Billion Equity Units Offering Mean For Investors?
headlines.summary: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) launched a public offering of equity units totaling US$1.75b. The utility plans to use the capital to repurchase existing convertible debt and repay short term borrowings. Remaining proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, affecting how Southern Company structures its financing mix. This equity units offering and planned debt repurchase only tell part of Southern Company's current investment story.

headlines.title: Southern Company announces equity units offering
headlines.summary: Southern Company (NYSE: SO) today announced it plans to sell 35 million equity units in a public offering. Each equity unit will be issued in a stated amount of $50 ($1.75 billion aggregate stated amount) and will consist of a contract to purchase Southern Company common stock in the future and two 1/40 undivided beneficial ownership interests in remarketable senior notes each having a principal amount of $1,000.

headlines.title: State Street Utilities SPDR (XLU) Sells NextEra and Southern on Nov. 5
headlines.summary: The fund sold $384.5 million of stock, cutting all 31 positions and adding nothing.

description: The Southern Company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electricity. The company offers electric service to retail customers and wholesale customers; and energy-related products and services to natural gas choice markets. It also develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates, and manages power generation assets, as well as battery energy storage projects; sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market; and deploys microgrids for commercial, industrial, governmental, and utility customers. In addition, the company is involved in the distribution of natural gas in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, and Tennessee; distributes energy and resilience solutions; and invests in telecommunications. The Southern Company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
